newsitem.title: USA: Merger unites range of Gillette, Duracell products.
newsitem.headline: Merger unites range of Gillette, Duracell products.

text.p: Here are the products made by Duracell International and the Gillette Co., which announced plans Thursday to merge:

The company's battery line includes alkaline, lithium, zinc air and nickel metal hydride rechargeable batteries used in all common household battery-operated devices as well as hearing aids and medical equipment. Duracell also sells zinc carbon type batteries.
Blades and razors under the Sensor, Atra, Track II, CustomPlus and Good News disposable razor names

Toiletries and cosmetics, including deodorants, anti-perspirants, shaving preparations, after-shave conditioners and fragrances under the Right Guard, Soft & Dri, Dry Idea and the Gillette Series brands.
Stationery products: Parker, Paper Mate and Waterman pens; Liquid Paper correction fluid products.
Braun hair removal products and personal care line, which includes oral care and hair care appliances, and Braun household appliances.
